_comment: Compatibility rules of a pipeline (source example -> sink example), read by tools/pipeline-builder/catalog.py (playground repro bootstrap --pipeline) and by the pipeline builder page. 'when': every field matches its regex (search). 'unless': a list of condition sets, any match cancels the rule. Fields: source.<fact>, sink.<fact>, source.config.<key>, sink.config.<key>, <side>.class; a missing field is ''. severity: fix (bootstrap applies add_to_sink to the sink config), warn, info.

rules.message: the source writes the Debezium envelope (before, after, op...): ExtractNewRecordState is added to the sink, so that it gets the row
the fully managed CDC source writes the envelope (after.state.only=false): set after.state.only=true in the source, or the sink gets before/after/op fields
the source writes values without a schema (String, ByteArray or JSON with schemas.enable=false), and the sink needs one: use an Avro, Protobuf or JSON Schema converter in the source
the sink writes Avro or Parquet files, which need a schema, and the source writes values without one: use an Avro, Protobuf or JSON Schema converter in the source, or a JSON format.class in the sink
the source writes values without a schema (output.data.format JSON, STRING or BYTES), and the sink needs one: use AVRO, PROTOBUF or JSON_SR in the source
the sink uses the record key (pk.mode=record_key): check that the source writes a non null key
the sink applies deletes (delete.enabled=true): only a CDC source writes the tombstones it expects
